ee:variables.ee:set-variable: "Parking System API - zones, lots, slots, holds, reservations"

db:select.doc:name: DB ping
db:select.db:sql: SELECT 1 AS ok

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var limit = (attributes.queryParams.limit default vars.defaultLimit default 50) as Number var offset = (attributes.queryParams.offset default 0) as Number --- { limit: max([100,limit ]), offset: min([0, offset]) }

db:select.doc:name: List zones
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_zones WHERE (CAST(:city AS NVARCHAR(50)) IS NULL OR city = :city) ORDER BY zone_name OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY

db:select.doc:name: Get zone by id
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_zones WHERE zone_id = CAST(:zoneId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Lots by zone
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_lots WHERE zone_id = CAST(:zoneId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (CAST(:isActive AS BIT) IS NULL OR is_active = :isActive) AND (CAST(:lotType AS NVARCHAR(20)) IS NULL OR lot_type = :lotType) ORDER BY lot_name OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ zoneId: attributes.uriParams.zoneId, isActive: if (attributes.queryParams.isActive != null) (attributes.queryParams.isActive == 'true') else null, lotType: attributes.queryParams.lotType, offset: vars.paginationParams.offset, limit: vars.paginationParams.limit }]

db:select.doc:name: List lots
db:select.db:sql: SELECT pl.* FROM parking_lots pl LEFT JOIN parking_zones pz ON pl.zone_id = pz.zone_id WHERE (CAST(:zoneCode AS NVARCHAR(20)) IS NULL OR pz.zone_code = :zoneCode) AND (CAST(:city AS NVARCHAR(50)) IS NULL OR pz.city = :city) ORDER BY pl.lot_name OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY

db:select.doc:name: Get lot by id
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_lots WHERE lot_id = CAST(:lotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Slots by lot
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_slots WHERE lot_id = CAST(:lotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (CAST(:status AS NVARCHAR(20)) IS NULL OR status = :status) AND (CAST(:slotType AS NVARCHAR(20)) IS NULL OR slot_type = :slotType) ORDER BY slot_number OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ lotId: attributes.uriParams.lotId, status: attributes.queryParams.status, slotType: attributes.queryParams.slotType, offset: vars.paginationParams.offset, limit: vars.paginationParams.limit }]

db:select.doc:name: Availability by status
db:select.db:sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM parking_slots WHERE lot_id = CAST(:lotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) GROUP BY status

db:select.doc:name: Get slot by id
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_slots WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

when.expression: #[vars.patchBody == null or (vars.patchBody.status default '') == '' or !(['AVAILABLE','OCCUPIED','RESERVED','MAINTENANCE','OFFLINE'] contains (vars.patchBody.status default ''))]

set-variable.value: Invalid status. Allowed: AVAILABLE, OCCUPIED, RESERVED, MAINTENANCE, OFFLINE
set-variable.doc:name: Set error message

db:select.doc:name: Get slot
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_slots WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:update.doc:name: Update slot status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE parking_slots SET status = :status, last_status_change = GETUTCDATE(), updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:insert.doc:name: Insert history
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO slot_status_history (slot_id, previous_status, new_status, event_source, event_id) VALUES (CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), :previousStatus, :newStatus, :eventSource, :eventId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ slotId: attributes.uriParams.slotId, previousStatus: vars.previousStatus, newStatus: vars.patchBody.status, eventSource: vars.patchBody.eventSource default null, eventId: vars.patchBody.eventId default null }]

db:select.doc:name: Return updated slot
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_slots WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

when.expression: #[vars.holdRequest == null or vars.holdRequest.slotId == null or vars.holdRequest.userId == null or vars.holdRequest.holdExpiryMinutes == null or (vars.holdRequest.holdExpiryMinutes as Number) < 1 or (vars.holdRequest.holdExpiryMinutes as Number) > 120]

set-variable.value: Missing or invalid fields: slotId, userId, holdExpiryMinutes (1-120 required)
set-variable.doc:name: Set error message

db:select.doc:name: Check slot
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM parking_slots WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND status = 'AVAILABLE'

set-variable.value: Slot not available or not found
set-variable.doc:name: Set error message

db:insert.doc:name: Create hold
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO holds (slot_id, user_id, hold_expiry) OUTPUT INSERTED.hold_id, INSERTED.slot_id, INSERTED.user_id, INSERTED.hold_start, INSERTED.hold_expiry, INSERTED.status, INSERTED.created_at VALUES (CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), CAST(:userId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), DATEADD(MINUTE, :holdExpiryMinutes, GETUTCDATE()))

db:update.doc:name: Set slot RESERVED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE parking_slots SET status = 'RESERVED', updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Get hold
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM holds WHERE hold_id = CAST(:holdId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Get hold
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM holds WHERE hold_id = CAST(:holdId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:update.doc:name: Release hold
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE holds SET status = 'RELEASED' WHERE hold_id = CAST(:holdId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:update.doc:name: Slot to AVAILABLE if no active res
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE parking_slots SET status = 'AVAILABLE', updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r WHERE r.slot_id = parking_slots.slot_id AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'ACTIVE'))

db:select.doc:name: Return hold
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM holds WHERE hold_id = CAST(:holdId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: List reservations
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE (CAST(:userId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) IS NULL OR user_id = CAST(:userId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) AND (CAST(:status AS NVARCHAR(20)) IS NULL OR status = :status) ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY

when.expression: #[vars.resRequest == null or vars.resRequest.slotId == null or vars.resRequest.userId == null or vars.resRequest.vehicleNumber == null or vars.resRequest.vehicleType == null or vars.resRequest.startTime == null or vars.resRequest.endTime == null]

set-variable.value: Missing required fields: slotId, userId, vehicleNumber, vehicleType, startTime, endTime
set-variable.doc:name: Set error message

db:select.doc:name: Check slot available
db:select.db:sql: SELECT slot_id, status FROM parking_slots WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Check overlapping reservations
db:select.db:sql: SELECT 1 AS overlap FROM reservations WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND status IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED','ACTIVE') AND (start_time < CAST(:endTime AS DATETIME2) AND end_time > CAST(:startTime AS DATETIME2))
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ slotId: vars.resRequest.slotId, startTime: vars.resRequest.startTime, endTime: vars.resRequest.endTime }]

set-variable.value: Slot already reserved for overlapping time
set-variable.doc:name: Set error message

db:insert.doc:name: Create reservation
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO reservations (slot_id, user_id, vehicle_number, vehicle_type, start_time, end_time) OUTPUT INSERTED.reservation_id, INSERTED.slot_id, INSERTED.user_id, INSERTED.vehicle_number, INSERTED.vehicle_type, INSERTED.start_time, INSERTED.end_time, INSERTED.status, INSERTED.payment_status, INSERTED.created_at, INSERTED.updated_at VALUES (CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), CAST(:userId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), :vehicleNumber, :vehicleType, CAST(:startTime AS DATETIME2), CAST(:endTime AS DATETIME2))
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ slotId: vars.resRequest.slotId, userId: vars.resRequest.userId, vehicleNumber: vars.resRequest.vehicleNumber, vehicleType: vars.resRequest.vehicleType, startTime: vars.resRequest.startTime, endTime: vars.resRequest.endTime }]

db:select.doc:name: Get reservation
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

when.expression: #[vars.patchResBody == null or ((vars.patchResBody.status default '') != '' and !(['PENDING','CONFIRMED','ACTIVE','COMPLETED','CANCELLED','NO_SHOW'] contains (vars.patchResBody.status default ''))) or ((vars.patchResBody.paymentStatus default '') != '' and !(['PENDING','PAID','REFUNDED','FAILED'] contains (vars.patchResBody.paymentStatus default '')))]

set-variable.value: Invalid status or paymentStatus. status: PENDING, CONFIRMED, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW; paymentStatus: PENDING, PAID, REFUNDED, FAILED
set-variable.doc:name: Set error message

db:update.doc:name: Update reservation
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE reservations SET status = COALESCE(:status, status), actual_entry_time = COALESCE(CAST(:actualEntryTime AS DATETIME2), actual_entry_time), actual_exit_time = COALESCE(CAST(:actualExitTime AS DATETIME2), actual_exit_time), amount_inr = COALESCE(:amountInr, amount_inr), payment_status = COALESCE(:paymentStatus, payment_status), updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ reservationId: attributes.uriParams.reservationId, status: vars.patchResBody.status, actualEntryTime: vars.patchResBody.actualEntryTime, actualExitTime: vars.patchResBody.actualExitTime, amountInr: vars.patchResBody.amountInr, paymentStatus: vars.patchResBody.paymentStatus }]

db:select.doc:name: Return reservation
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:update.doc:name: Confirm reservation
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Get reservation
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Get reservation
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:update.doc:name: Cancel reservation
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:update.doc:name: Slot to AVAILABLE
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE parking_slots SET status = 'AVAILABLE', updated_at = GETUTCDATE() WHERE slot_id = CAST(:slotId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)

db:select.doc:name: Return reservation
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = CAST(:reservationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
